{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for confounding
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(completed_orders['channel'], completed_orders['customer_segment']))

# Check if the distribution of customer segments differs by channel
channel_segment_dist = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nNormalized distribution of customer segments by channel:")
print(channel_segment_dist)"}
